description: Source code for power management testing in Zephyr RTOS, including thread management, sleep state transitions, latency measurement, and counters.

methods.name: notify_pm_state_entry
methods.description: Handles actions on entering a power management state, updates counters, and checks latency.

methods.name: notify_pm_state_exit
methods.description: Handles actions on exiting a power management state, updates counters.

methods.name: pm_check_counters
methods.description: Checks and logs entry/exit counters for power states, issues warnings on mismatches.

methods.name: pm_trigger_marker
methods.description: Marks the start of sleep residency measurement.

methods.name: pm_exit_marker
methods.description: Marks the end of sleep residency measurement and logs duration.

methods.name: task_a_thread
methods.description: Thread function for thread A, sleeps periodically.

methods.name: task_b_thread
methods.description: Thread function for thread B, sleeps periodically.

methods.name: create_tasks
methods.description: Creates and starts thread A and B.

methods.name: destroy_tasks
methods.description: Aborts and joins thread A and B.

methods.name: test_pwr_mgmt_multithread
methods.description: Performs power management testing with multiple threads over specified cycles.

methods.name: test_pwr_mgmt_singlethread
methods.description: Performs power management testing with a single thread over specified cycles.
